text:
samira: hey all :wave: I'm a new SWE on infra team. Quick question about sandbox API keys — we've got a small load test this afternoon and I want to make sure we don't hit limits. what are the default sandbox quotas (requests/min, concurrent requests, token rate)?

devex: welcome, samira! for sandbox most teams get a low-traffic quota by default. common defaults are around 60 requests/min and a few concurrent requests (varies by account). tokens/sec is throttled for very large streams. can you share expected qps and payload sizes?

samira: rough plan: spike to ~50 rps for 5 minutes to simulate bursty traffic, each request generates ~800 tokens (mostly output). will run from a single CI runner in us-east-1.

infra-ops: heads up — single-runner 50 rps + 800 tokens per response is likely to hit sandbox protections. if you keep it short and spaced it's usually fine, but sustained bursts may trigger rate-limit blocks. do you have a dev project id?

samira: project id is project-qa-42. we can stagger workers but would prefer a short burst. is there a self-serve way to request a temporary bump?

devex: yes — you can open the quota request form in Console -> Usage -> Quota Requests, or ping infra-ops here and we can open a temporary uplift. include the project id, start/end times, and target rps. for urgent runs, @infra-ops can approve short windows.

alex_k: fwiw I did a similar test last month. infra approved a 1-hr bump to 200 rps. just make sure you set REDWOOD_API_KEY in CI and don't leak it in logs.

samira: thanks. do keys expire? can we create a short-lived key for CI?

jlee: keys from the Console can be created as "ephemeral" (expires after X hours) or standard long-lived. for CI we usually create an ephemeral key with the minimal scopes and rotate per-run. also remember to pin to a specific model if you need deterministic perf.

ben_p: technical note — when you do the curl tests, add a max_tokens cap and explicit model param to avoid unexpected long responses. example: 

```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"model":"open-redwood-1-small","input":"...","max_tokens":800}'
```

infra-ops: pinged the quota form. if you want me to expedite, reply here with the time window. also note sandbox rate-limits are per-project by default; if you need cross-project capacity mention that.

samira: can we also whitelist our CI runner IP for the test? makes debugging easier.

infra-ops: we can allowlist IPs for short windows if you include the CIDR. send it in the quota request.

onboarding-bot: reminder: new-hires checklist item "Request sandbox quota" is still open for @samira — mark complete after you get approval.

samira: done — submitted form: https://console.redwood.ai/projects/project-qa-42/usage/quota-requests (filled for 1763459000-1763462600 UTC, target 150 rps). thanks everyone!

devex: noted, we'll watch and I put a short alert rule on the project for rate-limit errors. :thumbsup:

alex_k: good luck. if anything blocks, DM infra-ops or drop a note here and we'll triage fast.

samira: will do, thanks all!
